svg.title: Connecting ChatGPT or Claude to the admin console
svg.desc: 1. The admin pastes the MCP address into the AI platform; the platform discovers the authorization server through well-known metadata. 2. The client registers by client metadata document, dynamic registration or pre-registration. 3. Authorization uses PKCE S256 on top of the existing Google login, and only admin or support staff may continue. 4. The consent screen offers 14 scopes: seven admin areas, each read or write. 5. Codes are hashed, single use and short lived; refresh tokens rotate and reuse revokes the connection. Each tool calls the real admin route, so roles, validation and audit still apply.
svg.text: Connecting ChatGPT or Claude to the admin console
on top of the existing Google
